- Add a second Microsoft test account, switch between accounts, and verify separate messages and drafts. Up to three accounts can be saved. Only the active account synchronizes; removing an inactive account forgets its saved sign-in and keeps its local data.
- In Settings, change the OneDrop account avatar and verify it appears on another device signed into the same account. Restore the default avatar.
- In Settings → About, check for updates. Store-installed desktop builds use Edge's extension updater. This check does not download external extension code or automatically restart OneDrop; OneDrop’s Install action applies a prepared store update after the user clicks it and active work has finished. Edge can also update store extensions through its own automatic update mechanism.
- The added `https://onedrop.sycamore.top/*` host permission supports public version metadata checks in the shared extension package. No Microsoft credentials are sent to this endpoint. Mobile packages use it to offer user-initiated downloads of official release files; desktop store updates remain managed by Edge.
- Existing text/file sharing, clipboard image paste, previews, downloads, message deletion and recycle-bin restoration should continue to work. Native Android/iOS installation changes do not add native installation privileges to the desktop extension.
